requirements.requirement: The system must map lead_sponsor.agency_class value 'NIH' to a predefined high credibility score within the range 0 to 1.
The system must map lead_sponsor.agency_class value 'Industry' to a predefined credibility score within the range 0 to 1 that is lower than NIH.
The system must map lead_sponsor.agency_class value 'Other' to a predefined credibility score within the range 0 to 1 that is lower than Industry.
The system must infer 'Academic' sponsor type when agency_class is not 'NIH' or 'Industry' and the sponsor name matches known academic patterns or classifications.
The system must assign a deterministic credibility score for inferred 'Academic' sponsors within the range 0 to 1.
The system must return the same credibility_score for identical sponsor input data across repeated executions.
The system must include collaborator influence by adjusting the base credibility_score when one or more collaborators are present.
The system must increase the credibility_score when at least one collaborator has agency_class 'NIH'.
The system must ensure the final credibility_score remains bounded between 0 and 1 after applying collaborator adjustments.
The system must handle missing lead_sponsor data by assigning a default fallback credibility_score within the range 0 to 1.
The system must handle unknown or unsupported agency_class values by assigning a fallback credibility_score categorized as lowest confidence.
The system must process collaborator lists with multiple entries without failure and incorporate their influence deterministically into the final score.
